SPECIES-PhysVal-08 completed. No numerical mismatch found.

Reviewed all five assigned files at **`9e6a2bf921656b6c389bf51c6391758996a25487`**; their SHA-256 values match the assignment. No files changed or native jobs run.

- Independently reclassified **all 5,000 Fatras 100 GeV electron events**, without calling the author classifier. Both CKF and ambiguity counts, fixed quality/matching, deterministic representatives, generated/conditional denominators, all 16 η bins, wrong charge, and complete residual/pull arrays agree.
- Verified actual species, masses, charges and **618,556 seed/track hypotheses**; full particle identities and associations remain distinct. All primary outcome records exist: **4,999 Alive, one KilledInteraction**. Fatras secondary parent fields are zero; they do not establish genealogy.
- All native ambiguity survivors have **at most two shared measurements** before quality selection.
- Independently reproduced Wilson intervals and **all 102 candidate bootstrap intervals**, each using 2,000 event resamplings.
- Independently checked actual ROOT persistence: **186,389 measurements, 310,174 frozen variance marginals**, 606,308 CKF candidates and 5,633 ambiguity candidates. All 5,000 event IDs remain, including 46/120 zero-candidate events. Every matched representative has its complete same-event six-parameter/six-sigma tuple.

Post-ambiguity results are **4,305/5,000 matched**, 358 unmatched candidates, 967 secondary matches, three duplicates and **520/4,305 wrong charges**. Conditional efficiency is 4,305/4,973; ≥10-inlier coverage is 4,115/5,000.

The material interpretation caveat is substantial: **2,285/4,305 momentum errors exceed 50%**; central |η|<0.5 relative-pT central68 width is **102.93%**. Wrong charges extend to |η|≈0.016. Narrow pull cores do not demonstrate calibrated uncertainties. Also, **1,053/4,308 primary-matched candidates contain nonprimary measurements**, consistent with the frozen ≥50% purity rule. The coordinator’s reported electron-warning amendment is outside the reviewed pin and needs the next source review.

The pinned report correctly incorporates the earlier mixed-match, time-cut, transport-failure, unmerged-response, SafeFatras and pion-tail caveats. New ROOT event-ID/unknown-volume gates close the identified coverage gaps. The completed four-case ROOT audit artifact uses **`cdc290a0d35e3ebcd03d7292d996c744bf182329`**; its SHA-256 is `2decff8061c9070d7a199df60f41c8a8654c594131f988e446984a99081ee4ee`. My independent ROOT check above covers the 100 GeV case.
